text: Joanna, a screenwriter, submitted her screenplay to a film festival and is anxious awaiting a producer or director's response. Nate recently made coconut milk ice cream, finding it rich and creamy and potentially his new favorite snack; he plans to try more flavors. He also baked a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries. Nate enjoys coconut, chocolate, and mixed berry flavors. Joanna recommended the film "Little Women."
